title: Generating Define-XML from metacore
text: definecore package provides direct path metacore object CDISC Define-XML document. complements existing defineR package (spreadsheet-driven) leveraging standardized metacore structure used across pharmaverse.

title: Generating Define-XML from metacore
code: load(metacore_example("pilot_ADaM.rda"))  # loads object named 'metacore'  write_define_xml(   metacore,   file = "define.xml",   define_version = "2.1",   study_name = "CDISCPILOT01",   study_description = "CDISC Pilot Study",   standard_name = "ADaM-IG",   standard_version = "1.1" )

title: Generating Define-XML from metacore
text: Review generated XML, add missing value-level metadata (WhereClauses), document leaves, validate official CDISC Define-XML schema use regulatory submission.

title: Generate CDISC Define-XML from Metacore Objects
text: Consumes metacore R6 objects (ds_spec, ds_vars, var_spec, value_spec, codelist, derivations) Generates ODM / Define-XML structure Supports Define-XML 2.0 2.1 (def:Standards) Maps datasets ItemGroupDef, variables ItemDef + ItemRef Handles codelists, derivations (MethodDef), origins Designed pharmaverse integration

title: Generate CDISC Define-XML from Metacore Objects

Full production use regulatory submissions may require: Complete value-level metadata (WhereClauseDef, ValueListDef) Document leaves / Annotated CRF / Supplemental Docs Analysis Results Metadata (ARM) Full schema validation CDISC XSDs Custom OID conventions HTML transformation (define.html) Contributions welcome expand coverage.

title: Write Define-XML from a metacore object — write_define_xml
text: Generates CDISC Define-XML (version 2.0 2.1) document metacore metadata object. output ODM-based XML file containing dataset (ItemGroupDef), variable (ItemDef), codelist, derivation (MethodDef) metadata suitable starting point regulatory submissions.

title: Write Define-XML from a metacore object — write_define_xml
code: write_define_xml(   meta,   file,   define_version = c("2.1", "2.0"),   study_oid = NULL,   study_name = "STUDY",   study_description = "Study Description",   protocol_name = study_name,   standard_name = NULL,   standard_version = NULL,   file_oid = NULL,   origin_default = "Derived",   quiet = FALSE )

title: Write Define-XML from a metacore object — write_define_xml
text: meta metacore object (R6 class). file Character string. Path output define.xml file. define_version Character. "2.0" "2.1". Default "2.1". study_oid Character. ODM Study OID. Default generated. study_name Character. Study name GlobalVariables. study_description Character. Study description. protocol_name Character. Protocol name. Defaults study_name. standard_name Character. Name content standard (e.g., "SDTM-IG", "ADaM-IG"). Used Define-XML 2.1 def:Standard. standard_version Character. Version content standard. file_oid Character. ODM FileOID. Default generated. origin_default Character. Default origin missing (e.g., "Derived"). quiet Logical. Suppress messages. Default FALSE.

title: definecore 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-11-04 Fixed examples: replaced \dontrun{} \donttest{} requested CRAN. Corrected example use load() metacore .rda example file. Example now writes temporary file cleans afterward.

title: definecore 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Core function write_define_xml() generate Define-XML 2.0/2.1 metacore objects. Support datasets, variables, codelists, basic derivations. Designed integration pharmaverse metacore ecosystem.
